pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant
Did He not bring their stratagem to naught
And send against them swarms of flying creatures
Which pelted them with stones of baked clay
And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant
Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray
And He sent against them Flights of Birds
Striking them with stones of baked clay
Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up
